# Third-party assets bundled with Django Orbit

Orbit serves these files from its own package so the dashboard works offline,
behind a strict Content Security Policy, and without trusting a CDN with the
data it displays. Exact versions are pinned in `frontend/package.json`; run
`npm run build` in `frontend/` to regenerate them (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).

| File | Library | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vendor/htmx.min.js` | htmx | 1.9.10 | BSD-2-Clause | https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx |
| `vendor/alpine.min.js` | Alpine.js | 3.17.4 | MIT | https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine |
| `vendor/alpine-collapse.min.js` | @alpinejs/collapse | 3.17.4 | MIT | https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine |
| `vendor/apexcharts.min.js` | ApexCharts | 3.44.0 | MIT | https://github.com/apexcharts/apexcharts.js |
| `vendor/lucide.min.js` | Lucide (icon subset only) | 1.59.0 | ISC (some icons also MIT, Feather) | https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide |
| `fonts/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | Inter (variable, latin subset, via Fontsource) | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/rsms/inter |
| `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | JetBrains Mono (variable, latin subset, via Fontsource) | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono |

The compiled stylesheet `css/orbit.css` is generated by Tailwind CSS 3.4.19
(MIT, https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss) from `frontend/input.css`.

## Notes

- `lucide.min.js` is not the full Lucide UMD build. It is bundled with esbuild
  from the icons listed in `frontend/build-icons.mjs` and exposes
  `lucide.createIcons()` as before. Add a name to that list when you use a new
  icon.
- Lucide 1.x no longer ships brand icons, so the footer GitHub link uses the
  generic `git-branch` icon.
- Fonts cover the Latin subset only; other scripts fall back to the system
  font stack (`system-ui`, `monospace`).
